title: Design System: Jacques Fuller Living Monograph

display.purpose: Artist names, artwork titles, and chapter statements.

body.purpose: Biography, metadata values, and explanatory copy.

label.purpose: Catalogue codes, metadata labels, navigation, and state.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Image readiness and restrained page arrival.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus-adjacent, and image state changes.

components.name: Selected Work
components.description: A large contained sculpture image paired with a temporary selection number, factual record, and visual observation.
components.css: .feature-work { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3rem; background: #e4e7e3; color: #182126; } .feature-work__image { grid-column: 1 / 8; background: #c9cfcb; border-radius: 0; } .feature-work h3 { font: 400 64px/.95 Georgia, serif; }

components.name: Archive Card
components.description: A compact complete-archive record subordinate to the six selected works.
components.css: .archive-card { border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #e4e7e3; color: #182126; text-align: left; } .archive-card__image { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #c9cfcb; } .archive-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #315fcb; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Catalogue Action
components.description: The rare cobalt action used to open a photographic sequence.
components.css: .catalogue-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 13px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #315fcb; color: #f4f6f2; font: 700 13px/1.2 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .catalogue-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #315fcb; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Artwork Viewer
components.description: A viewport-bounded oxide catalogue record with persistent image controls and a paper narrative chapter.
components.css: .viewer { position: fixed; inset: 0; overflow: auto; background: #101a20; color: #edf1ed; border-radius: 0; } .viewer__opening { min-height: calc(100svh - 64px); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4fr 8fr; } .viewer__stage { min-height: 0; background: #19272e; }

components.name: Living Archive Chapter
components.description: An oxide chapter that exposes future Voice, Studio, and Record paths without fabricating missing source material.
components.css: .living-archive { padding: 96px 32px; background: #101a20; color: #edf1ed; } .living-archive h2 { font: 400 88px/.9 Georgia, serif; }

components.name: Metadata Record
components.description: A two-column fact group with explicit unconfirmed values and fine oxide rules.
components.css: .metadata { border-top: 1px solid #36474e; color: #edf1ed; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .metadata div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr; min-height: 44px; border-bottom: 1px solid #36474e; }

narrative.overview: Six works form a temporary exhibition within an expandable family archive. Monumental serif typography and cool mineral surfaces provide monograph authority; explicit placeholders and deep oxide record chapters preserve the honesty of work still being documented.
keyCharacteristics: Six-work curatorial sequence before the complete archive
Large contained sculpture photography rather than decorative crops
Monograph serif paired with narrow catalogue labels
Cool mineral surfaces and deep oxide record environments
Visible placeholders where the record remains incomplete

rules.name: The Natural Brass Rule
rules.body: Never use gold as an interface accent. Brass belongs in the artwork photography.

rules.name: The Reversible Selection Rule
rules.body: The selected six are temporary curation, not a permanent ranking or claim of importance.

rules.name: The Honest Archive Rule
rules.body: Existing detail photographs may demonstrate the archive, but must not be presented as workshop evidence or artist testimony.

dos: Do preserve complete sculptures with object-fit: contain.
Do keep catalogue uncertainty explicit until confirmed.
Do let voice, tools, notes, and old records expand the archive later.
donts: Don't round cards or turn metadata into pills.
Don't infer dates, symbolism, provenance, or availability from photographs.
Don't imply that sculpture details are workshop photographs.
Don't require a formal portrait or generate a substitute.
